name: A vow to make the blade whole

date.label: Wrath of the Lich King, patch 3.3.5 quest sequence; exact in-world date unknown

summary: The sword’s breaking does not end its history. Myralion vows that the Sunreavers will restore it; Caladis leads the Silver Covenant along its separate path. The two representatives are shown here as a comparative split scene, not as companions sharing one event. Their promise gives purpose to the work ahead: remake the blade, face the will bound within it, and seek a cleansing strong enough to remove what the Scourge has left.
